$comment: Tessera Phase 0 benchmark gate (AD-22 / A-16 / NFR-11). This root path is the single authority. Baselines are measured on the committed codex-anonymized-v1 fixture by server/tests/performance_baseline.rs. Each threshold is exactly 2 times its observed positive integer baseline in the metric unit.

fixture.$comment: Versioned repository-safe fixture used for every Phase 0 baseline and regression run.
fixture.name: codex-anonymized-v1

cold_scan.$comment: Wall time to scan a Confirmed Source from cold into a fresh Derived Index. Higher is worse.

collection.method: production scan_source against a fresh temporary Derived Index per trial

query.$comment: P50 and P95 wall time for a keyword query against the active generation. Higher is worse.

collection.method: production query path across every declared fixture query

memory.$comment: Tessera process RSS while the active generation is loaded. Higher is worse.

collection.method: child test process scans and queries the active generation, then reads its own ps RSS in KiB multiplied by 1024

index_size.$comment: On-disk size of the main Tessera Derived Index SQLite file produced by the current production scan/query path. This is not a separate FTS5 index-size measurement. Higher is worse.

collection.method: metadata length of the main SQLite file after a successful production scan

gate.$comment: Quality-gate policy. A regression is any metric exceeding its threshold on the same fixture. The default Rust suite runs server/tests/performance_baseline.rs, which reports measured values without source text or query text.
